        int mod = sc.nextInt();

        if (n == 1) {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }

        long result = 0;
        List<long[]> z = new ArrayList<>();
        z.add(new long[]{1});
        long aaa = 0;

        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {

            long[] nz = new long[size];

            long[] d = new long[zOld.length + 1];

            for (int w = zOld.length - 1; w >= 0; w--) {

                nz[w] = ((d[L] - d[R + 1]) % mod + mod) % mod;
            }

            long[] e = new long[d.length + 1];
            long[] f = new long[d.length + 1];

            for (int jj = 0; jj <= zOld.length - i - 1; jj++) {

                bbb = (bbb + ((e[R2 + 1] - e[L]) * (i + 1 + jj) + (f[R2 + 1] - f[L])) * zOld[jj]) % mod;
            }

            long rr = zOld.length - 1;
            long A = factorial(n).divide(factorial(n - i));
            aaa = (aaa + (bbb * A.longValue()) % mod) % mod;

            z.add(nz);
        }

        System.out.println(aaa % mod);
    }

    static BigInteger factorial(int num) {
        BigInteger res = BigInteger.ONE;
        for (int i = 2; i <= num; i++) {
            res = res.multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(i));
        }
        return res;
